name: acm-pca
description: This is the Amazon Web Services Private Certificate Authority API Reference.

subcommands.name: create-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Creates a root or subordinate private certificate authority (CA).

subcommands.name: create-certificate-authority-audit-report
subcommands.description: Creates an audit report that lists every time that your CA private key is used to issue a certificate.

subcommands.name: create-permission
subcommands.description: Grants one or more permissions on a private CA to the Certificate Manager (ACM) service principal (acm.amazonaws.com).

subcommands.name: delete-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Deletes a private certificate authority (CA).

subcommands.name: delete-permission
subcommands.description: Revokes permissions on a private CA granted to the Certificate Manager (ACM) service principal (acm.amazonaws.com).

subcommands.name: delete-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource-based policy attached to a private CA.

subcommands.name: describe-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Lists information about your private certificate authority (CA) or one that has been shared with you.

subcommands.name: describe-certificate-authority-audit-report
subcommands.description: Lists information about a specific audit report created by calling the CreateCertificateAuthorityAuditReport action.

subcommands.name: get-certificate
subcommands.description: Retrieves a certificate from your private CA or one that has been shared with you.

subcommands.name: get-certificate-authority-certificate
subcommands.description: Retrieves the certificate and certificate chain for your private certificate authority (CA) or one that has been shared with you.

subcommands.name: get-certificate-authority-csr
subcommands.description: Retrieves the certificate signing request (CSR) for your private certificate authority (CA).

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource-based policy attached to a private CA.

subcommands.name: import-certificate-authority-certificate
subcommands.description: Imports a signed private CA certificate into Amazon Web Services Private CA.

subcommands.name: issue-certificate
subcommands.description: Uses your private certificate authority (CA), or one that has been shared with you, to issue a client certificate.

subcommands.name: list-certificate-authorities
subcommands.description: Lists the private certificate authorities that you created by using the CreateCertificateAuthority action.

subcommands.name: list-permissions
subcommands.description: List all permissions on a private CA, if any, granted to the Certificate Manager (ACM) service principal (acm.amazonaws.com).

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags, if any, that are associated with your private CA or one that has been shared with you.

subcommands.name: put-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to a private CA.

subcommands.name: restore-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Restores a certificate authority (CA) that is in the DELETED state.

subcommands.name: revoke-certificate
subcommands.description: Revokes a certificate that was issued inside Amazon Web Services Private CA.

subcommands.name: tag-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to your private CA.

subcommands.name: untag-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Remove one or more tags from your private CA.

subcommands.name: update-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Updates the status or configuration of a private certificate authority (CA).

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: audit-report-created
subcommands.description: Wait until a Audit Report is created It will poll every 3 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: certificate-authority-csr-created
subcommands.description: Wait until a Certificate Authority CSR is created It will poll every 3 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: certificate-issued
subcommands.description: Wait until a certificate is issued It will poll every 1 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
